title: Unidentified objects repeatedly appearing over sensitive nuclear sites

tellings.quote: you know, like there are things in the sky we can't identify that repeatedly show up around our most sensitive nuclear sites.

plain: Things in the sky that no one can identify are said to show up again and again around the most sensitive nuclear sites in the United States. Michels states this himself, without naming a source, as a reason to take the subject seriously, since it would mean something unknown is taking an interest in the country's most dangerous weapons.
